# Approved general asset references — 4 September 2026

These fourteen files were supplied and approved by the user as **general ImmoScout24 asset references**. They prove established composition, cropping, hierarchy, logo placement and photographic treatments. They are not permission to carry consumer-facing copy or journey-specific colours into Professionals work.

## Professionals transfer rule

- Keep the composition principle; rewrite the message for the selected Professionals audience and formal `Sie` address.
- Use only the Professionals palette named in `brand/tokens.json`: Teal, Professionals Blue, Charcoal, White and Sand.
- Never carry purple or yellow from a reference into a Professionals asset.
- Never set customer-facing text in all caps. Use sentence case and the approved Make It Better roles.
- Never carry a Plus name, Plus claim, Plus symbol, informal `Du/Dir/Deine` address or consumer journey message into Professionals.
- Treat these flattened files as evidence, not as editable production masters. Their baked-in copy, logo and colour cannot be separated safely.
